name: 01-cover-drive.jpg
caption: Golden hour on Ocean Boulevard: chase-cam behind the Solaris GT, a two-star patrol cruiser on its rear quarter, traffic both ways, strollers on both pavements, the Art Deco hotels with neon marquees on the right, palms and the beach on the left, Mission 02 on the objective card and the full HUD with the vector minimap.

name: 02-police-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star sunset pursuit: interceptors on the supercar's bumper, the police helicopter's searchlight pinning it, a V roadblock ahead, siren light on the wet boulevard, tyre smoke, flashing wanted stars and red/blue police cones on the minimap.

name: 03-on-foot-heist.jpg
caption: Mission 03 on foot in Neon Midtown: over-the-shoulder SMG firefight with the vault guards, tracers and muzzle flash, the gold mission beacon, a stealable muscle car at the kerb with its F prompt, and the GPS route on the minimap.

name: 04-city-map.jpg
caption: The city menu (M) over the night skyline: the full vector map of Solaris Bay with mission, activity, garage, police and ramp blips, the respect rank, the five-job story arc, four side activities with best times, and the Safehouse Garage upgrades and car collection.
